title: Fighter
description: data/fighters/<id>.json (YOK-136): body numbers of one fighter that are not a move's. The id is the fighter (kit) id that moves name as 'source'. A fighter without a file, or a field left out, keeps the fight-wide default.

push_width.description: Push-box width in gameplay units (200 per metre, E1), centred on the fighter. Push is 1-D: two grounded fighters' centres stay at least the mean of their two widths apart. Left out = SimConfig.BodyWidth (120). At most the screen-wall separation (1,060, E1).
